text:
Kai: Morning — quick runway: landing copy sprint for Hosted API / Dedicated / Private (VPC & on-prem). Need final hero line, one benchmark hint, webinar CTA, and the routing payload for registrants. Can we lock by EOD?
Rina: I can take the hero variants. Goal: developer-first, production tone. I9ll post three tight options per mode by 11:30.
Owen: I9ll confirm bench strings. Reminder: legal said use "Private (VPC & on-prem)" and prefer "customer-managed keys (CMK)" & "audit trail" terminology.
Talia: For conversion, CTA should be short + a microline. Proposed CTA: "Save my seat 94 live benchmark + Q&A". Microline: "Includes benchmark walkthrough and 15-min office hours." Thoughts?
MarComBot: Meeting scheduled: https://calendar.example/evt/4995001234. Reminders 24h + 1h.
Kai: Good. Also routing rules: tag leads with deployment_interest and size_bucket. Basic bucketing: >=1000 -> enterprise-sales, 250-999 -> AE/SDR, <250 -> growth. If deployment_interest=="Private" and size>=500 -> escalate to enterprise-sales.
Rina: Draft heroes (short) 

Hosted H1: "Hosted API 94 ship LLM features in minutes"
Hosted H2: "Hosted API 94 production inference, zero infra"
Hosted H3: "Hosted API 94 low-latency text, chat, embeddings"

Dedicated D1: "Redwood Dedicated 94 reserved GPU pools for consistent throughput"
Dedicated D2: "Redwood Dedicated 94 SLA-backed performance, pin models"
Dedicated D3: "Redwood Dedicated 94 predictable latency for customer-facing apps"

Private P1: "Private (VPC & on-prem) 94 your network, our runtime"
Private P2: "Private (VPC & on-prem) 94 CMK, audit trail, and on-prem options"
Private P3: "Private (VPC & on-prem) 94 enterprise control over inference"

Rina: Micro-lines (one each): Hosted: "p95 ~140ms (chat, 8k)"; Dedicated: "sustained 25k tokens/min per pool"; Private: "same runtime, in your network".
Owen: For Hosted, use canonical: "p95 135ms (chat, 8k)" from the April run. For Dedicated, say "sustained 22-28k tokens/min per pool" (avoid exact single point). No public pricing.
Talia: CTA variants: "Save my seat 94 live benchmark + Q&A" / "Join the launch demo: perf, rollout, controls" / "See it live: Hosted & Dedicated walkthrough". I favor variant 1.
Kai: Agree variant 1 + microline. Also add small trust line under hero: "Benchmarks from production-like workloads" linking to the bench doc.
Owen: Pasting sample webhook payload for forms wiring (simple fields):

```
{
  "email": "lead@example.com",
  "name": "Alex Lead",
  "company": "Example Inc",
  "employee_count": 1200,
  "deployment_interest": "Dedicated",
  "utm_campaign": "launch-2026"
}
```

Owen: Map deployment_interest -> contact.tags (hosted/dedicated/private) and employee_count -> size_bucket.
Rina: Minor phrasing tweak: change "audit logs" to "audit trail" in Private copy (legal). Done.
Talia: Action list: Rina to pick Hosted H2, Dedicated D2, Private P2 as final heroes and add micro-lines; Owen to post bench doc link and confirm canonical strings; Kai to create GH issue for routing mapping; Forms/MarTech to wire webhook and tags. 4pm review: @Rina @Owen @Talia.
MarComBot: Registration form created: https://forms.example/launch-2026 94 mapped fields: email,name,company,employee_count,deployment_interest,utm_campaign.
Kai: Great work. If we lock hero + CTA today we can stage pages and enable registration CTA for the campaign. :rocket:
Rina: Posting final copy by 11:30 and a quick hero mock in design channel.
Owen: Will attach bench doc after the 9:45 run.
Talia: I'll prep the CTA microcopy and form microline.
Kai: Thanks team 94 see you at review.
